title: QUTest: A Native Testing Framework for Quantum Programs
summary: Quantum programs are often shared as OpenQASM 3 circuits, but tests are still written in host languages such as Python with Qiskit. We present QUTest, a native framework in which both programs and tests are standard .qasm files. Tests follow the Arrange / Act / Assert pattern, while configuration, runtime requirements, and assertions are encoded as pragma comments (//%), preserving compatibility with existing OpenQASM tools.
